issue.title: Record the decision that ref tasks live with their parent note

task_type_fields.proposed_change:
Add the accepted decisions record `decisions/ref-tasks-live-with-their-parent.md` ("Ref Tasks Live With Their Parent Note") plus its roster line in `decisions.md`. Epic bob-cli-5y's auto decision memory_ref_parent_decision = no skipped it; every phase (bob-cli-5y.1 through 5y.14) proposed it as a follow-up.

Content the epic plan specified (plan:202610/ref_tasks_live_with_parent.md, closeout step 3):
- Applies to: bob-cli, bob-plugins, Bob Mac Capture, the vault.
- Claim (R1-R8 in short): an open reference has exactly one `#task #ref` reading task in a root area/project/inbox note's `## Tasks`; its residence is the reference's parent (frontmatter `parent` is a projection); `#ref` plus a path-qualified link to the ref note is identity and `^ref-<slug>` is only an address; ref tasks carry no `#hide` and count in lanes, caps, Today, and pickers; the one review exception is that due Ready refs walk REFERENCES on `reference_interval` (never NEW, never decide) while Next/Pending refs walk their lanes daily; bob-cli is the only authority for grammar and parent resolution.
- Why: the rejected alternatives in the research report (`research:202610/ref_tasks_move_into_parent_notes/ref_tasks_move_into_parent_notes.md`): in-note `^ref` trackers with `#hide` (invisible to lanes, caps, Today, pickers; `^ref` collisions; drifting hand-written wrappers), a `## References` section or other non-archiving home (J6 out of scope).
- Cost: lane and cap pressure (Next 18/15, Pending 18/10 right after migration), a vault-wide locator walk per command (+40-80 ms measured by bob-cli-5y.5), Mac `bob` install coupling for scans.
- Reopens when: `orphan_ref_task` appears in practice, or the daily lane review of refs is rubber-stamped.
- Evidence: the research report, the plan, and commits e0ba61b, e04c421, 9041927, 4016229, 7e838c8, e6aa7a4, 8905153, 091eda9, f315c58 (bob-cli); 947615d, a0a417a (bob-plugins); aa47c1f, f51cdc1 (bob-mac-capture).
- Link [[task-lanes-are-sticky]], [[review-walk-is-tiered]], [[note-ready-cap-counts-the-lane]], [[mac-capture-is-a-thin-client]].

Coordinate with bob-cli-51 and bob-cli-5d (sibling ref-library decision records whose claims this epic changed; both carry context notes). Closing requires Bryan's permission plus `sase memory init`.

issue.creation_reason: Epic bob-cli-5y changed where reference reading tasks live and how they are identified and reviewed, but its auto decision memory_ref_parent_decision=no skipped the decisions record; every phase proposed it.
